label: GO step after an unrewarded a1->S1 (common) trial
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2) and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (99% of mass has prev_reward == 0; never when in_rew == 1). The strongest and most specific case is the previous trial being a1 -> S1 (common) with no reward: that predicate has dev precision 0.96 and holds 75% of activation mass. Most of the missing recall is at rel -3, where the previous trial lies outside the window and prev_action is unknown; allowing unknown history (isin(prev_state,[1,-1]) & isin(prev_action,[1,-1])) raises dev mass recall to 0.91 but lowers precision to 0.61. Weaker activations (up to ~0.6 of max) also show up after unrewarded a2 -> S2 trials and other unrewarded outcomes, and activation is larger later in the episode (trials 50-89). It does not fire after rewarded trials, or on D1/D2 steps. It uses only observed history (the last outcome), so no future variables.
